JOB_STATUS : Status der Kommunikation - OKAY, wenn fehlerfrei
STAT_LV_BLS_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - brake pedal
STAT_LV_CS_CRU_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - clutch pedal
STAT_LV_DRIV_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - P/N/D engaged or no valid forward ratio
STAT_LV_N_CRU_AUTH_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - engine speed outside of operating range
STAT_LV_VS_CRU_ON_AUTH_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - road speed outside of operating range
STAT_LV_ASR_MSR_ACT_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - traction control active
STAT_LV_VS_RATIO_DFT_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - vehicle speed below 70% of stored speed
STAT_LV_CRU_SWI_ON_OFF_1_ACTIVE : Cruise suspension byte 1 - O/I switch pressed
